user.title: Connect to BKW
user.description:
1. Open this link in your browser and log in:
{authorize_url}

2. After login you are redirected to my.bkw.ch/energy. Copy the `code` parameter from the address bar.

3. Paste the code below.

metering_point.title: Metering point
metering_point.description: Enter your metering point code (Messpunkt) from the BKW portal. You can find it in the browser network tab on metering-data requests as meteringPointCode, or in the portal URL.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid authorization code or expired session. Generate a new link and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to BKW. Try again later.
error.invalid_metering_point: Could not load data for this metering point. Check the code on my.bkw.ch (Mein Energiemonitoring) and try again.
error.invalid_metering_point_length: Metering point code must be between 20 and 40 characters.
error.invalid_data_type: Could not load metering data. Open the energy chart on my.bkw.ch, copy the dataType from a metering-data request in DevTools, and enter it above (default: PRODUCTION_BKW).
